dict.string: $(PICHI_PRODUCT_NAME) needs Accessibility permission to listen for global hotkeys and type text into other apps when you stop recording.
$(PICHI_PRODUCT_NAME) needs microphone access to record your voice for speech-to-text transcription. Speech recognition runs on this Mac. AI enhancement may use a provider you configure.
Use your location once when an in-room meeting starts to save its address. Apple resolves the address from the location.

$(PICHI_PRODUCT_NAME) needs system audio access to record the selected application or all system audio, according to your meeting settings. Meeting audio stays on this Mac.
$(PICHI_PRODUCT_NAME) needs Screen & System Audio access to record the selected application or all system audio, according to your meeting settings.
$(PICHI_PRODUCT_NAME) needs permission to control system events for managing launch at startup settings.
$(PICHI_PRODUCT_NAME) uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your voice commands and text quickly and privately.
